title: Kentucky blocks Beta from red monopoly
description: Kentucky blocks Beta from red monopoly. Buying Kentucky blocks Beta's red monopoly and preserves enough cash to keep trading. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

Buying blocks Beta's monopoly and strengthens my position. It's the optimal move.
